summary: This bill disapproves a rule issued by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services concerning updates to the Medicare Home Health Prospective Payment System, Quality Reporting Program, Value-Based Purchasing, and other related policies for Calendar Year 2025, thereby preventing the rule from taking effect.

scores.thoughts: This bill disapproves a rule from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services concerning Medicare's home health prospective payment system, quality reporting, and other Medicare policies. By rejecting these updates, the bill directly impacts the administration and structure of a major public healthcare program, thus affecting public healthcare.
